claims.text: Union Minister Chirag Paswan stated on Friday regarding CJP's protest that 'They are the youth of India. Nobody can stop them.'
Union Minister Chirag Paswan previously called for clarification regarding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's decision-making but backed out after the Election Commission stated decisions were unanimous.

The Cockroach Janta Party released a poster calling for supporters to gather at Jantar Mantar at 10 a.m. on October 10, 2026, demanding the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar and the rollback of the Special Intensive Revision.
Delhi Police denied permission to the Cockroach Janta Party to hold a protest at Jantar Mantar on October 10, 2026, citing alleged rule violations in an earlier demonstration.
Authorities deployed 23,000 security personnel and closed 45 metro stations across Delhi ahead of the planned CJP protest.
The Union Ministry of Home Affairs directed all States and Union Territories to coordinate with Delhi Police to prevent protesters from moving toward Delhi.
CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke stated on X that he would reach Delhi by 9:30 a.m. and urged protesters to keep the protest going even if he is detained.
NSUI Jamia Millia Islamia Secretary Ebin Basil reported that four female students were detained by police near Jamia around 11:30 p.m. before being released around 3 a.m.
The Centre alleged that over 200 police personnel were injured during CJP's protest in July.
In an open letter, 42 retired judges defended Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and criticized CJP-led protests against the Election Commission of India.
In May 2014, the BJP staged protests against the Election Commission of India after its prime ministerial candidate Narendra Modi was denied permission to hold a rally in Varanasi.

Delhi Police sent a letter on October 9 to CJP co-convener Saurav Das and joint secretary Balkrishna stating their communication on October 7 did not constitute a proper application submitted 10 days in advance.
Delhi Police reported identifying 2,873 people via CCTV from a July 20 march, claiming 989 of them had criminal antecedents.
Delhi Police stated that Jantar Mantar has an official capacity to accommodate around 1,000 people at a time.
The Trump administration suspended eight major tech companies, including TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HCLTech, Microsoft, Adobe, Cognizant, and Capgemini, from the US PERM program on October 8.
US Labor Secretary Keith Sonderling announced that US authorities will stop accepting new applications and processing pending ones under the PERM program for the affected firms.
India's Ministry of External Affairs stated that the US PERM suspension does not advance shared ambitions and affects green card processing, though existing H-1B visas remain valid.
Tata Consultancy Services stated in a stock exchange filing that it submitted fewer than 10 PERM applications over the past two years and still plans to hire 15,000 US employees over five years.
India's Ministry of External Affairs issued an official statement on October 9 regarding the US immigration restrictions.
Pan IIT Alumni India urged IIT graduates to return to India to work, citing uncertainty in US immigration policies.
PanIIT Alumni India Chairman Prabhat Kumar stated, 'A visa was never a stable foundation for a career... Build here. Scale here. Die here.'
Indian nationals received 71% of all H-1B visas issued by the US in the 2023-24 financial year.
US Vice President JD Vance urged US companies to hire 'great American workers' instead of 'foreign indentured servants'.
India's Ministry of External Affairs called US Vice President JD Vance's comments deeply offensive and unwarranted.
MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal stated that talent mobility adds value to both the Indian and US economies and helps US companies with cutting-edge talent and job creation.
TVK won two assembly bypolls in Tamil Nadu, securing victories in Dharapuram and Madurantakam.
In Tamil Nadu, TVK's P Sathyabama won Dharapuram by 9,471 votes, and Maragatham Kumaravel won Madurantakam by 20,040 votes.
The bypoll wins increased TVK's tally in the 234-member Tamil Nadu assembly from 107 to 109 seats.
In West Bengal, the BJP retained the Nandigram assembly seat and won the Rejinagar assembly seat from AJUP.
BJP candidate Shankharavh Sarkar won the Rejinagar assembly bypoll in West Bengal by 75,816 votes.
In Assam, BJP's Devasish Sharma won the Nagaon Lok Sabha seat, leading AIUDF's Badruddin Ajmal by over 1.5 lakh votes.
AINRC candidate Ashok Anand won the Thattanchavady assembly bypoll in Puducherry by over 8,400 votes.
AJUP leader Humayun Kabir announced he will move to Dubai after completing a promised mosque following his son's bypoll loss in Rejinagar.
Raijor Dal chief Akhil Gogoi demanded the resignation of Assam Congress president Gaurav Gogoi following the party's defeat in the Nagaon Lok Sabha by-election.
Akhil Gogoi stated that Congress's minority vote share in Nagaon dropped from 25% to 5%.

Meta took down a viral video posted by AJUP leader Golam Nabi Azad alleging BJP candidate Shankharav Sarkar improperly entered an EVM booth in Rejinagar following a legal request from Indian authorities.
Official Rejinagar bypoll results showed BJP's Shankharav Sarkar won with 1,29,914 votes while Azad received 54,098 votes.
In Nandigram, BJP's Hasirani Rath defeated Congress candidate Milan Pradhan by 1,22,753 votes.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that the bypoll victories reflect the public's deep connection with the NDA's good governance agenda.
